title: YouTube AdFree
shortDescription: Development build with playback-request diagnostics and broader Shorts removal.
description: GTV development build of YouTube AdFree, built from webosbrew upstream 0.5.3. DEV revision 9 retires the ineffective standalone isAdPlayback=true mutation while retaining isAdPlayback observation, upgrades the on-TV report to diagnostics v6 with privacy-safe outbound playback-request instrumentation for isInlinePlaybackNoAd, and broadens Remove Shorts handling for direct renderer/view-model reel navigation, direct Shorts content/style enums, and Shorts startup behaviours. Every Shorts removal remains controlled by the existing Remove Shorts setting.

added: Diagnostics v6 playback-request section showing safe request structure, isInlinePlaybackNoAd state before and after patching, whether the copy-on-write patch ran, and whether the final serialized body actually contained isInlinePlaybackNoAd=true.
High-confidence Shorts recognition for direct renderer/view-model navigationEndpoint/onSelectCommand/onTap reelWatchEndpoint paths and direct Shorts content/style enums.
Privacy-safe Shorts URL-path clue detection for surviving schemas without retaining the URL itself.
changed: Shorts survivor scanning is deeper and records more schema-only clues so mixed-in Shorts on channel video lists can be identified if a new card form still survives.
DEV version advanced to 9690.5.3 / GTV revision 9 and the on-TV diagnostic title advanced to v6.
fixed: Removed the revision 7 standalone isAdPlayback=true neutralizer after hardware testing proved that changing the boolean to false did not prevent the advertisement.
Remove Shorts now also suppresses direct Shorts guide/startup entries and modern direct reel-navigation card forms while the existing Remove Shorts toggle is enabled.
